authority.organization: Kentucky Finance and Administration Cabinet, Office of Equal Employment Opportunity and Contract Compliance

official_sources.title: Office of Equal Employment Opportunity and Contract Compliance

current_process.action: A covered procurement identifies an apparent low bidder/selected consultant or other contractor requiring Kentucky EEO Contract Compliance review.

Provide the required EEO information through the contracting agency using the current Finance-developed process/forms. Current Finance guidance identifies intent to comply, workforce breakdown and subcontractor information among required information.
Transmit the EEO information to the Office of EEO and Contract Compliance.

current_process.actor: Office of EEO and Contract Compliance
current_process.action: Review the information, currently described as within ten days of receipt, and determine whether more information is needed or the contractor/vendor should be approved.
Approval qualifies the vendor to bid on covered Kentucky EEO Act contracts without filing additional data for one year.

safeguards: Do not treat the expiration date alone as authorization to send an unsolicited recertification packet.
Current KYTC instructions state Finance does not pre-approve vendors and unsolicited submissions are not processed or returned.
Use only current Finance-developed forms/processes supplied through the contracting context; do not reuse historical forms solely because they were accepted in prior years.
Keep this Contract Compliance approval separate from RTEC's FTA/KYTC EEO/Affirmative Action Plan lifecycle.

rtec_current_state.interpretation: The current approval expires soon, but the evidence set does not establish that RTEC presently has a covered procurement or agency request requiring a new submission. This remains a trigger-based currentness question rather than an automatic annual filing task.

agent_behavior.recommended_prompt: Check whether RTEC has a current Kentucky state bid/contract, apparent-low-bidder status, selected-consultant notice, or direct Contract Compliance request that triggers a new EEO approval workflow.
agent_behavior.consequential_action: Any external EEO compliance submission remains human-approved.

privacy: Organization-level compliance process only; no employee-level workforce breakdown or signatory PII is stored in this record.
